title: [SPECFLOW] IMPROVE-04: isolated workspace and external side-effect guardrails
body:
Epic: #171 · Story: IMPROVE-04 · Declared tier: `spec:thin`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC-04-1: A run records starting ref/workspace and cannot modify the protected base branch directly.
- [ ] AC-04-2: Prohibited external side effects are blocked before execution and recorded as blockers, not merely discouraged in prompts.
- [ ] AC-04-3: A retained improvement has an independently identifiable commit/change set; a reverted experiment leaves no product diff while preserving its evidence.
- [ ] AC-04-4: Crash/interruption cannot leave a successful status for an unknown workspace or unrecorded mutation.
- [ ] AC-04-5: Existing human-only release/merge/override rules remain authoritative.
